verdict.label: FAIL as-built + ENGINE HANDEDNESS BUG (confirmed). As-built predictions track realized lift for LH batters (pearson +0.22) but ANTI-correlate for RH (pearson -0.17) — the infield_shift template shades toward 1B regardless of batter hand, so it is aimed wrong for RH pull hitters. Pooled, the as-built shift recommendation is NOT prescriptively valid (pearson -0.04, sign-agree 0.46). After mirroring the shift for RH, predictions POSITIVELY but WEAKLY track realized lift (pearson +0.14, spearman +0.21, slope +1.39 CI [+0.37,+2.45] — includes 1) with magnitude under-predicted (the template is a gentle lean, not a real shift). The out-model is a real-but-weak alignment simulator once handedness is fixed. Fix: flip the shift by batter handedness, then re-test.
